total_model.summary: Model projects 47.3 total points (CIN 31, TEN 16). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 1.5), Combined rush defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 1.1), Combined defense EPA allowed/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 1.1). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
